intro.zh: 包含环氧罩光清漆、溶剂型丙烯酸透明起砂处理剂，以及用于室外地坪的单组份耐紫外线面漆。
intro.en: Includes an epoxy gloss clear coat, a solvent-based acrylic clear dusting treatment for concrete, and a one-component UV-resistant topcoat for outdoor floors.

summary.zh: 环氧罩光清漆（A组份BATOV-6001）与配套罩光清漆固化剂（B组份BATOV-G601），是基于德国拜耳的环氧罩光产品，具有优良的耐化学品性、柔韧性、耐磨性、抗刮伤性、耐候性，以及环境友好、VOC含量低、符合环保法规要求、容易施工等优点，可以用于环氧平涂和环氧自流平等地坪涂料的罩光。产品符合国家标准GB/T 22374-2008《地坪涂装材料》中有害物质限量及性能的要求。
summary.en: Epoxy gloss clear coat (Part A BATOV-6001) with matching clear-coat hardener (Part B BATOV-G601) is based on Bayer (Germany) epoxy clear-coat technology. It offers excellent chemical resistance, flexibility, abrasion resistance, scratch resistance and weatherability, is environmentally friendly with low VOC, meets environmental regulations and is easy to apply. It is used as a clear top layer over epoxy roller-applied and epoxy self-leveling floor coatings. The product meets the hazardous-substance limits and performance requirements of GB/T 22374-2008 "Floor coating materials".

uses.zh: 适用于对地面的美观、舒适有较高要求的场合，适用于对地坪的弹性、耐磨性、耐刻划性有较高要求的场合，适用于对地坪的耐化学品性能有较高要求的场合，包括：办公室、学校、图书馆、医院、体育场馆、展示室、餐厅、超市等民用地坪；电器、电子、汽车、机械、铸造、纺织、化工、制药、食品、饮料、饲料、烟草等行业的实验室、生产车间、包装区域、仓库等工业地坪。
uses.en: For floors with high requirements for appearance and comfort, for elasticity, abrasion and scratch resistance, and for chemical resistance. Civil floors: offices, schools, libraries, hospitals, sports halls, showrooms, restaurants, supermarkets. Industrial floors: laboratories, production workshops, packaging areas and warehouses in the electrical, electronics, automotive, machinery, foundry, textile, chemical, pharmaceutical, food, beverage, feed and tobacco industries.

v.zh: 1．待施工的面漆表面必须清洁、无明水，在面漆的重涂间隔内施工。2．先将B料用电动搅拌机低速（300转/分钟）搅拌均匀，按规定配比加入A料，再用电动搅拌机低速搅拌3~5分钟，静置10~20分钟，待气泡基本消除后再开始施工。3．为防止漏涂，建议分两遍施工，待第一遍涂料实干后再进行第二遍施工。
v.en: 1. The surface to be coated must be clean, free of standing water, and coated within the recoat interval. 2. Stir Part B evenly with an electric mixer at low speed (300 rpm), add Part A in the specified ratio, stir at low speed for 3–5 minutes, then let stand for 10–20 minutes until bubbles have mostly disappeared before applying. 3. To avoid missed spots, apply in two coats, applying the second coat after the first is through dry.

v.zh: 5~35℃，材料密封储存在干燥、阴凉、通风良好的仓库中，运输时应防止雨淋、日晒，避免碰撞。冬季运输和储存时要注意保暖措施，防止冰冻。
v.en: 5–35 °C; store sealed in a dry, cool, well-ventilated warehouse; protect from rain and sun during transport and avoid impacts. In winter, keep warm during transport and storage to prevent freezing.

summary.zh: 透明起砂处理剂（A组份BATOV-6001）与配套起砂处理剂固化剂（BATOV-G601），属溶剂型的丙烯酸聚合物涂料，作为混凝土起砂处理凝固剂使用，具有优异的渗透与凝结性能，能有效地凝结起砂疏松的混凝土结构，提高混凝土的强度及凝聚力。涂装体系具有防尘防潮、耐磨、施工快捷、维护方便等特点，性价比高，是一般生产车间、仓库的首选涂装系统。一般需要两遍涂装工序。本产品易燃易爆、有毒，具有刺激性，使用前应采取相应的防护措施。
summary.en: Clear concrete dusting treatment (Part A BATOV-6001) with matching hardener (BATOV-G601) is a solvent-based acrylic polymer coating used as a consolidant for dusting concrete. It penetrates and binds well, effectively consolidating dusting, loose concrete and increasing its strength and cohesion. The system is dust-proof, moisture-proof and abrasion resistant, quick to apply and easy to maintain, and is a preferred system for ordinary workshops and warehouses. Generally two coats are required. Warning: the product is flammable, explosive, toxic and irritating; take suitable protective measures before use.

uses.zh: 用于疏松混凝土素地的巩固与防尘。
uses.en: Consolidating loose concrete substrates and controlling dust.

v.en: Trowel/scraper spreading or roller application. Recommended: (1) for flat, smooth, sound substrates use scraper spreading; (2) for dusting, rough, weak substrates use roller application.

v.en: Keep the work area ventilated and dust-free, but avoid strong wind, which blows in dust and spoils the surface appearance.

v.zh: 涂膜实干期间严禁接触水、溶剂等介质，严禁承压，踩踏。
v.en: Until the film is through dry, keep it away from water, solvents and other media, and do not load or walk on it.

v.zh: 应当由专业的承包单位进行该产品的施工，且承包单位必须按照产品的施工说明进行施工。
v.en: Application should be carried out by a professional contractor following the product application instructions.

v.zh: 详情请咨询巴特夫技术人员。飞溅到地板的化学品应及时清洁，因化学品蒸发后浓度会比原来更高。
v.en: Consult BATOV technical staff for details. Clean up chemical spills promptly, as the chemical becomes more concentrated after evaporating.

v.zh: 干燥时间是在标准条件（25℃，60%湿度）下测定，仅供参考。在不同的温度和湿度下干燥速度有比较大的差异，还受漆膜厚度、通风状况、下层涂料等影响。通常，当温度升高时，干燥时间缩短；当温度降低时，干燥时间加长。
v.en: Drying times are measured under standard conditions (25 °C, 60% humidity) and are for reference only. Drying speed varies considerably with temperature and humidity, and is also affected by film thickness, ventilation and the underlying coating. Generally, higher temperature shortens and lower temperature lengthens drying time.

summary.zh: 耐紫外线地坪面漆（单组份BATOV-6002），主要用于室外地坪漆的面涂层涂装，是一种单组份、色彩多样化、无接缝的平涂型室外地坪面漆。涂装表面平滑美观、颜色一致、持久不变；干燥后无气味、无毒无害。适用室外地坪涂装系统薄涂型面漆。一般需要两遍涂装工序。
summary.en: UV-resistant floor topcoat (single-component BATOV-6002) is mainly used as the topcoat of outdoor floor coating systems. It is a one-component, multi-colour, seamless, roller-applied outdoor floor topcoat. The surface is smooth and attractive with consistent, lasting colour; odourless, non-toxic and harmless once dry. Suitable as the thin-film topcoat of outdoor floor systems. Generally two coats are required.

uses.zh: 用于室外地坪涂装系统，适用于运动场地（篮球场、网球场、羽毛球场等）和露天停车场地面的首选涂装体系。
uses.en: For outdoor floor coating systems; the preferred system for sports courts (basketball, tennis, badminton, etc.) and open-air car parks.
